findings.highlight:
Trying not to look at the
 blood
findings.evidenceJa: 傷口を見ないようにして
findings.governingReading: Trying not to look at the wound.
findings.explanation: The mature branch replaces the visible wound with blood, changing the object Shirou avoids seeing.

findings.highlight: Sakura doesn’t raise her head to look at me
findings.evidenceJa: 桜は顔をあげず、力なく床に座り込んでいる
findings.governingReading: Sakura does not lift her face and sits collapsed weakly on the floor.
findings.explanation: Sakura’s weakness and floor-level collapsed posture disappear.

findings.highlight: because of all the things I’ve hidden from her
findings.evidenceJa: 今までの隠し事が原因なのか
findings.governingReading: whether it is because of what she has kept hidden until now
findings.explanation: The English reverses whose concealment might be causing Sakura to avoid the conversation.

findings.highlight: I realize that Tohsaka is behind me
findings.evidenceJa: いつのまにか遠坂がやってきていた
findings.governingReading: Tohsaka had arrived behind them without Shirou noticing when.
findings.explanation: The unnoticed arrival is reduced to Shirou realizing her static location.

findings.highlight: Even though it’s not fatal
findings.evidenceJa: 即死ではないものの戦闘は不可能だろう
findings.governingReading: Although it did not kill her instantly, she is probably unable to fight.
findings.explanation: A wound that was not instantly lethal may still be fatal; the English certifies that it is not.

findings.highlight: I think it’s illogical to call it unfair
findings.evidenceJa: 衛宮くんを卑怯者呼ばわりするのは筋違いだわ
findings.governingReading: Calling Emiya-kun a coward is beside the point.
findings.explanation: The English replaces Shinji’s accusation against Shirou’s character with an abstract complaint that the situation is unfair.

findings.highlight: Are you still concerned about it!? She’s just a quiet bitch that shrinks with fear! Look, I’m a Master!
findings.evidenceJa: おまえも衛宮と同類かよ！　よく見ろ、僕はマスターになったんだ！
findings.governingReading: Are you the same as Emiya too? Look closely: I became a Master.
findings.explanation: The mature branch erases Shinji’s comparison between Rin and Shirou and invents a gendered insult and characterization of Sakura.

findings.highlight: You shouldn’t worry about them! You should just be concerned about me
findings.evidenceJa: おまえもマスターなら、気にかけるのは桜じゃなく、僕だけだって決まってるんだよ
findings.governingReading: If you are a Master too, naturally you should concern yourself with me alone, not Sakura.
findings.explanation: The mature branch removes the Master-to-Master premise, replaces Sakura with an indeterminate plural, and weakens Shinji’s entitled demand.

findings.highlight: if you’re a legitimate Master
findings.evidenceJa: 貴方が一人前のマスターなら
findings.governingReading: if you are a full-fledged or competent Master
findings.explanation: Rin challenges Shinji’s practical competence; the English instead challenges the legitimacy of his status before the later reveal.

findings.highlight: Shinji scrambles away
findings.evidenceJa: 慎二は俺たちから離れつつ
findings.governingReading: Shinji takes out a book while moving away from them.
findings.explanation: The English adds panicked, hurried movement.

findings.highlight: you bitch
findings.evidenceJa: 間抜け
findings.governingReading: you fool
findings.explanation: Shinji’s insult becomes a gendered slur, sharpening and sexualizing his abuse of Rider.

findings.highlight: You just shut up and take care of that piece of trash
findings.evidenceJa: さあ、桜を返して貰うぞ
findings.governingReading: Now, I’ll have you give Sakura back.
findings.explanation: The mature branch deletes Shinji’s stated aim of reclaiming Sakura and invents an order involving unnamed trash.

findings.highlight: Clutching her stomach, she
findings.evidenceJa: 桜は[ruby text=うな]魘されるように声をあげ
findings.governingReading: Sakura cries out as though tormented by a nightmare.
findings.explanation: The mature branch adds a specific stomach-clutching action absent from the source.

findings.highlight: The power flowing from her body
findings.evidenceJa: その体から発する威圧
findings.governingReading: the intimidating pressure emanating from her body
findings.explanation: The English replaces Rider’s oppressive presence with generic power.

findings.highlight: long hair flutters right above me
findings.evidenceJa: 長い髪が通過していった
findings.governingReading: long hair passed directly over Shirou.
findings.explanation: The attack’s directed passage over Shirou becomes decorative fluttering.

findings.highlight: She lands opposite us[line3]between Shinji and the rest of us
findings.evidenceJa: 慎二のいる場所より少し前、俺たちと慎二の中間に着地する
findings.governingReading: She lands on the opposite side from Shirou and Rin, slightly in front of Shinji, midway between the two sides.
findings.explanation: The English omits Rider landing slightly forward of Shinji and blurs the two-sided geometry.

findings.highlight: Who told you to bring Sakura?
findings.evidenceJa: 僕の命令は戦えって
findings.governingReading: My order was for you to fight.
findings.explanation: The mature branch invents a question about bringing Sakura and removes the explicit content of Shinji’s order.

findings.highlight: her expression is frighteningly cold
findings.evidenceJa: その視線はぞっとするほど冷たかった
findings.governingReading: Despite the leather belt covering her eyes, her gaze was chillingly cold.
findings.explanation: The English replaces the deliberate paradox of a cold gaze through covered eyes with a generic facial expression.

findings.highlight: the book which granted you false ownership, so I can no longer obey you
findings.evidenceJa: [ruby text=ぎしん char=2]偽臣の書が失われた以上、貴方には付き合えない
findings.governingReading: Now that the Book of the False Attendant is gone, Rider will no longer go along with Shinji.
findings.explanation: The English drops the named ritual object, invents ownership, and narrows Rider’s refusal to obedience.

findings.highlight: I knew it was strange
findings.evidenceJa: おかしいとは思ってたわ
findings.governingReading: I did think it was strange.
findings.explanation: The English promotes Rin’s prior suspicion into knowledge.

findings.highlight: I can’t say anything
findings.evidenceJa: 喉がうまく動かない
findings.governingReading: My throat will not move properly.
findings.explanation: A concrete bodily failure under shock becomes a generic inability to speak.

findings.highlight: the pain on my hand
findings.evidenceJa: ナイフを掴んだ手の痛み
findings.governingReading: the pain in the hand that gripped the knife
findings.explanation: The cause and physical context of Shirou’s hand pain disappear.

findings.highlight: my mind isn’t surprised at all
findings.evidenceJa: 心は、さして驚いていなかった
findings.governingReading: his heart was not especially surprised
findings.explanation: The English turns limited surprise into none at all.

findings.highlight: she didn’t want me to know
findings.evidenceJa: 俺にだけは知られたくなかったと、謝罪しているようだった
findings.governingReading: Her gesture seemed to apologize that Shirou alone was the person she had not wanted to learn this.
findings.explanation: The English removes the apparent apology and the pointed restriction to Shirou alone.

findings.highlight: you lost your right as a Master at the same time
findings.evidenceJa: その間、桜はマスターとしての権限を失い、ただの魔術師になる
findings.governingReading: During that interval, Sakura loses her authority as Master and becomes an ordinary magus.
findings.explanation: The Classic branch voices Shirou’s internal explanation as new Rin dialogue and changes Sakura from third person to direct address.

findings.highlight: Shinji raises his arm
findings.evidenceJa: 兄の仮面が剥がれ落ちようとしている
findings.governingReading: His mask as an older brother is about to peel away.
findings.explanation: The mature branch removes the characterization of Shinji’s collapsing brotherly façade and inserts a raised-arm action.

findings.highlight: I will kill you
findings.evidenceJa: 排除されるだけの存在です
findings.governingReading: you will simply be someone to be eliminated
findings.explanation: Rider’s impersonal classification of Shinji as an obstacle becomes a direct personal death threat.

findings.highlight: a fake Command Spell
findings.evidenceJa: 借り物の令呪
findings.governingReading: a borrowed Command Spell
findings.explanation: The English calls the genuine Command Spell authority borrowed from Sakura counterfeit, blurring the mechanism just explained.

findings.highlight: I have no talent
findings.evidenceJa: 僕には魔術の才能はない
findings.governingReading: I have no talent for magecraft.
findings.explanation: Shinji’s specific lack of magical aptitude becomes a general claim of having no talent at all.

findings.highlight: This was all just a farce
findings.evidenceJa: こんなのは遊びだ
findings.governingReading: This was only a game or plaything.
findings.explanation: The English changes Shinji’s dismissive claim that the conflict was play into an admission that it was fraudulent or absurd.

findings.highlight: you have no right
findings.evidenceJa: アンタにもう目はない
findings.governingReading: you no longer have any chance
findings.explanation: Rin says Shinji has no remaining prospect of success; the English instead denies a right or entitlement.

findings.highlight: You’re going to obey me like always, right?
findings.evidenceJa: 言うことを聞いてくれよ、可愛い僕の妹だろ？
findings.governingReading: Listen to me; you are my dear little sister, are you not?
findings.explanation: The mature branch replaces manipulative familial affection with an invented history of habitual obedience.

findings.highlight: Sakura clenches her fists
findings.evidenceJa: ぎゅっと片腕を握り締め
findings.governingReading: Sakura tightly grips one arm.
findings.explanation: The English changes Sakura’s self-protective one-arm grip into bilateral clenched fists, altering her posture and emotional presentation.

findings.highlight: All right. Then you can die
findings.evidenceJa: なら、おまえの好きなようにしてやるよ
findings.governingReading: Then I will let you have things as you wish.
findings.explanation: The mature branch replaces Shinji’s ominously indirect concession with an explicit death sentence.

findings.highlight:
the sound of
 glass breaking
findings.evidenceJa: 何かの割れる音がした
findings.governingReading: the sound of something breaking near Sakura
findings.explanation: The mature branch identifies the deliberately unknown broken object as glass and omits its location near Sakura.

findings.highlight: hold it against that old man for making your body like that
findings.evidenceJa: 爺を恨んでくれ
findings.governingReading: Blame the old man rather than me.
findings.explanation: The mature branch adds a causal explanation about Zouken making Sakura’s body this way before the scene identifies the mechanism.

findings.highlight: Shinji runs away
findings.evidenceJa: 逃げるように走り去っていく
findings.governingReading: Shinji runs off as though fleeing.
findings.explanation: The comparison marking Shinji’s departure as flight disappears.

findings.highlight: tears at
findings.evidenceJa: 苦しげに胸を押さえる
findings.governingReading: She clutches her chest in pain.
findings.explanation: The mature branch changes a protective clutch into violent clawing or tearing.

findings.highlight:
She goes into convulsions.[lr]
   No, it’s worse
findings.evidenceJa: 膝をついたまま震える桜
findings.governingReading: Sakura trembles while remaining on her knees.
findings.explanation: The mature branch medicalizes the trembling as convulsions and invents a narrator correction escalating it further.

findings.highlight: if you feed her without care
findings.evidenceJa: 下手に[ruby text=かて o2o=1]魔力を与えては戻せなくなる
findings.governingReading: If you carelessly give her magical energy—read here as nourishment—she cannot be restored.
findings.explanation: The English preserves the nourishment reading but drops the written magical-energy mechanism from Archer’s warning.

findings.highlight: My chest is burning
findings.evidenceJa: 肌が焼ける
findings.governingReading: My skin burns.
findings.explanation: The bodily location of the corrosive field’s effect moves from the skin generally to Shirou’s chest.

findings.highlight: melts everything within its framework, on this premise
findings.evidenceJa: この敷地内にいるモノを溶かす
findings.governingReading: melts whatever is within these grounds, inside its framework
findings.explanation: The English’s “on this premise” is a malformed substitution for the school grounds and obscures the bounded physical area.

findings.highlight: before Sakura is consumed
findings.evidenceJa: サクラが虫に食われる前に
findings.governingReading: before Sakura is eaten by the worms
findings.explanation: The agents consuming Sakura are omitted, concealing the Matou-specific mechanism.

findings.highlight: protect your Master by ignoring mine
findings.evidenceJa: 私のマスターより自身のマスターを守ろうとしている
findings.governingReading: You too are trying to protect your own Master over mine.
findings.explanation: Rider’s comparison of competing priorities becomes an accusation that Archer is simply ignoring Sakura.

findings.highlight: the corrosive boundary field
findings.evidenceJa: この胃袋みたいな結界
findings.governingReading: this stomach-like bounded field
findings.explanation: The visceral stomach metaphor becomes a clinical judgment about corrosion.

findings.highlight: Sakura from becoming a heretic
findings.evidenceJa: 桜が外道に落ちる
findings.governingReading: Sakura falling onto an inhuman or evil path
findings.explanation: The English frames Sakura as doctrinally heterodox rather than falling into monstrous, unethical conduct.

findings.highlight: she’s sucking on other people’s air, or magical energy in this case
findings.evidenceJa: 他人の[ruby text=さんそ char=2]魔力を吸いたがってる
findings.governingReading: In pain and wanting oxygen, she wants to drain other people’s magical energy—read as oxygen.
findings.explanation: The English turns Sakura’s desire into ongoing action and awkwardly claims she is sucking other people’s air before correcting itself.

findings.highlight: Archer is overwhelming
findings.evidenceJa: アーチャーが圧倒していた
findings.governingReading: Archer was overwhelmingly dominating Rider.
findings.explanation: The English leaves “overwhelming” without an object, obscuring the observed direction of the fight.

findings.highlight: It’s strange
findings.evidenceJa: たしかに、それにしては妙だった
findings.governingReading: Indeed, considering that apparent superiority, something was strange.
findings.explanation: The English drops the logical relation between Archer’s apparent advantage and the lack of progress.

findings.highlight: Being forced to protect someone should put her at a disadvantage
findings.evidenceJa: ライダーの本領は疾風の如き襲撃で、防衛戦には向いていない
findings.governingReading: Rider’s true forte is a gale-like assault; she is unsuited to defensive battle.
findings.explanation: The English repeats the defensive disadvantage while omitting the positive description of Rider’s combat specialty.

findings.highlight: with his other sword
findings.evidenceJa: 残る右剣で
findings.governingReading: with the remaining sword in his right hand
findings.explanation: The English loses which sword remains available during the simultaneous exchange.

findings.highlight: the boundary field is slowly taking his energy
findings.evidenceJa: 結界は徐々に体力を奪っていく
findings.governingReading: the bounded field gradually drains his physical stamina
findings.explanation: “Energy” blurs physical endurance with the magical energy discussed throughout the scene.

findings.highlight: being in the hallway stabs at our minds
findings.evidenceJa: ザクザクと意識が削られていく
findings.governingReading: their consciousness is being harshly scraped away merely by remaining in the hallway
findings.explanation: The English replaces progressive loss of consciousness with an unnatural metaphor of minds being stabbed.

findings.highlight: “Damn[line4]”
findings.evidenceJa: 「チ[line4]」
findings.governingReading: A tongue-click: “Tch.”
findings.explanation: A nonlexical click of frustration becomes spoken profanity and is then redundantly followed by narration of the click.

findings.highlight: It will be easier for me to kill you
findings.evidenceJa: その方が気兼ねなく手を下せる
findings.governingReading: That way Rider too can act or strike without reservation.
findings.explanation: The English supplies Archer as the target and death as the outcome where Rider states only that she can act without restraint.

findings.highlight: She releases the black seal
findings.evidenceJa: 黒い封印を排除した
findings.governingReading: She removes the black seal.
findings.explanation: “Releases the seal” can mean applying or unleashing it, obscuring the concrete act of removing the face restraint.

findings.highlight: composed of ether
findings.evidenceJa: [ruby text=エーテル char=6]第六架空要素で出来ている
findings.governingReading: composed of the Sixth Imaginary Element, read as ether
findings.explanation: The English preserves only the ruby and deletes the written cosmological classification.

findings.highlight: nature that the gods cursed
findings.evidenceJa: 神が[ruby text=のろ]妬った天性か
findings.governingReading: an inborn gift the gods envied—read as cursed
findings.explanation: The English follows the ruby while reversing divine envy of an innate gift into the gods actively cursing a vague “nature.”

findings.highlight: My blood is thickening
findings.evidenceJa: 血液が固まっていく
findings.governingReading: His blood is solidifying.
findings.explanation: The progressive petrification of the blood is weakened to thickening.

findings.highlight: A single action magic that magi have
findings.evidenceJa: [ruby text=シングルアクション char=3]一工程の魔術行使
findings.governingReading: spellcasting performed in a single step, read as Single Action
findings.explanation: The English produces a malformed pseudo-category instead of explaining a one-step magical operation.

findings.highlight: Extreme luck
findings.evidenceJa: 凶運
findings.governingReading: misfortune or calamitous luck
findings.explanation: The valence is reversed: harmful fate becomes exceptionally good luck.

findings.highlight: How great a miracle is it
findings.evidenceJa: どれほどの神秘なのか
findings.governingReading: what an extraordinary Mystery it represents
findings.explanation: The English substitutes miracle for the setting’s technical concept of Mystery.

findings.highlight: Breaker Gorgon
findings.evidenceJa: [ruby text=ブレーカー char=4]自己封印・[ruby text=ゴルゴーン char=4]暗黒神殿
findings.governingReading: Self-Seal: Dark Temple, read as Breaker Gorgon
findings.explanation: The English preserves only the ruby name and removes the written Noble Phantasm title.

findings.highlight: sealed by the powers of shrines
findings.evidenceJa: 神域の力によって封じられた
findings.governingReading: sealed by the power of a divine domain
findings.explanation: A divine precinct or domain becomes the power of plural physical shrines.

findings.highlight: evil beasts and spirits in the age of the gods
findings.evidenceJa: 神代の魔獣、聖霊
findings.governingReading: monstrous beasts and holy spirits of the Age of Gods
findings.explanation: The English adjective makes both classes sound evil and drops the explicit holiness of the second.

findings.highlight: from within Rider
findings.evidenceJa: ライダーの奥から
findings.governingReading: from farther behind Rider
findings.explanation: The attack’s spatial origin moves from beyond Rider to inside her body.

findings.highlight: she will be impaled by the spear
findings.evidenceJa: 遠坂は槍に胸を貫かれる
findings.governingReading: Tohsaka will have her chest pierced by the spear.
findings.explanation: The English omits the chest as the specifically anticipated point of impact.
